recommendations.name: hmarr/auto-approve-action
recommendations.description: The simplest and best-known option: approves a PR from a workflow, and you limit it to trusted actors (for example Dependabot) with an if condition, but it runs on pull_request_target so scope it tightly.

recommendations.name: Greptile auto-approve PRs
recommendations.description: An AI review tool that approves only PRs with a clean review and within a maximum risk level you set (start at Low), so it judges actual risk instead of just who opened the PR.

recommendations.name: github/privileged-requester
recommendations.description: Approves PRs from listed trusted authors only if commits, labels and a removals-only diff checks pass, which is a good low-risk filter, but note the repo was archived in November 2025 so it is read-only and unmaintained.
